purpose: Memorialize how EVERYTHING connects: the spine is to help people use AI better by moving each unit of work unbounded+inefficient -> most-bounded+most-efficient, on context kept true/current/provable, defined by capability, getting smarter over time. The CORE products (Baltor, Teleon) CONSUME content from the Open*Hub surfaces (context packs, harnesses, model info, methods, receipts...). Names are cross-checked against the authoritative family source (dist/sites/openharness-design/shared/products.js) so this map can never silently omit a surface.

amazon_strategy.principle: Each Open*Hub is built as INTERNAL infrastructure that Baltor/Teleon consume first, with the ability to spin it out as a PUBLIC, independently-monetizable Open*Hub.io registry later — the AWS pattern (internal infra -> public revenue stream).
amazon_strategy.open_trigger: a credible competitor launches in the hub's lane OR a planned public-release milestone — whichever first — AND owner domain/trademark clearance (per architecture/candidate_open_hubs.json).

stages.live: dual-use: already a live open registry AND internal infra the core consumes
stages.private_bench: internal-first: private infra now; a public-revenue candidate when its trigger fires

dependency_law: Baltor -> Teleon -> OpenHarnessHub/Open*Hubs, NEVER reverse (enforced by check_portfolio_dependency_law). Content flows hub -> core (the core CONSUMES from hubs); a hub never depends on the core.

hubs.name: OpenEndpointHub
hubs.provides: LLM endpoint + gateway due-diligence (model info, data-class/jurisdiction)

hubs.name: OpenRoutingHub
hubs.provides: model-routing POLICY (preference cards, lane policy, model info)

hubs.name: OpenOptimizationHub
hubs.provides: pack-shaping methods (summarize/distill, unstructured->structured, fit budget = the descent)

hubs.name: OpenVerificationHub
hubs.provides: verification methods (bind claim->source, prove by hash, hold out the unprovable)
